posts.hook: the same week anthropic's revenue tripled, one of its biggest holders scrambled to sell
posts.caption: anthropic's revenue tripled to $65b in a year even as a major backer sold its stake under pressure, trump's ai advisor publicly clashed with dario amodei over regulation, and cursor launched a github rival the same day github went down. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: anthropic's revenue tripled to $65b in a year, ahead of a possible ipo
slides.desc: up from $9b just eight months ago, growth accelerating not slowing

terms.gloss: a company's first sale of stock to the public

slides.title: the fund that bet biggest on anthropic is now selling its stake at a discount
slides.desc: situational awareness already dumped its public portfolio to citadel in july

slides.title: trump's ai advisor publicly rebutted anthropic's ceo on regulation
slides.desc: sacks says amodei's oversight plan would centralize power, not prevent it

slides.title: cursor launched a github rival the same day github went down
slides.desc: pull requests, reviews and ci built into the editor

terms.gloss: automated tests that run every time code changes

slides.title: an ai agent found a bug that another ai agent had introduced, at snowflake
slides.desc: wiz's red agent read snowflake's internal jira for five days undetected

slides.title: brazil banned discord livestreams nationwide after a 13 year old's death
slides.desc: regulators found the platform failed to shield minors from self-harm content
